Polite requests often use je voudrais (I would like), which you can learn as a whole phrase. French uses avoir for age: j'ai vingt ans means I am twenty. Learn useful forms in messages: je suis (I am), j'ai (I have), je vais (I go), je fais (I do), je viens (I come), je prends (I take), je peux (I can), je veux (I want). Polite requests often use je voudrais (I would like), which you can learn as a whole phrase. French uses avoir for age: j'ai vingt ans means I am twenty. Check the form when the subject changes: nous sommes means we are.
